description: Complete simulatePocCamera responses for the 64 poc-projection-reuse-reference cases, produced by the referenceCommit on Node 24 (V8, linux-x64). Each response, with the pre-#271 depth-of-field expression substituted, hashes to the historical responseSha256 (or the #276 intentional crop hash); test/poc-projection-reuse.test.ts checks that anchor engine-independently.

assumptions: Paraxial Gaussian thin-lens model
Distances are measured from ideal principal planes
Real-lens focus breathing and pupil magnification are not modeled
Ideal rectilinear paraxial thin-lens projection
Sensor plane uses the thin-lens image distance for the supplied focus distance
Real-lens focus breathing and distortion are not modeled
Signed sensor-plane bounds are measured relative to the optical axis.
Ideal rectilinear paraxial thin-lens projection
Sensor plane uses the thin-lens image distance for the supplied focus distance
Real-lens focus breathing and distortion are not modeled
Signed sensor-plane bounds are measured relative to the optical axis.
Ideal circular aperture
Monochromatic wavelength

primarySubjectDiagnostics.comparisonCaution: Sampling, defocus diameter, diffraction diameter, motion path, and camera-shake path are different physical indicators and must not be directly summed into a sharpness score.

provenance.note: Calculated from Photivra open-engine analytical models.
